elevation._sourceNote: Max corrected from a previously published 220m after real SRTM-derived elevation sampling (via api.open-elevation.com) against the surveyed KML boundary showed a substantial hill region (12% of the panchayat's area) above 220m, peaking near 494m — likely near the southern reserve-forest edge. Not a single outlier: the top 15 sampled points form a smooth gradient from 494m down to 432m.
